headline: Frontline Flare at Fishermans Row, Godcrofts, Tempest
war_summary: Since the 06:11 edition the map has heated up on three western sectors. Fishermans Row recorded four base changes in the last two hours, the latest at 08:42 Z, pushing its day‑total to fifteen flips. Godcrofts logged a single capture at 07:25 Z, while Tempest Island saw four exchanges, the most recent at 08:25 Z, raising its six‑hour count to four. Farranac Coast and Lykos Isle remain active but have added no new flips since 04:10 Z and 03:38 Z respectively. In the north, Dead Lands still shows a high tempo with five ownership events in the past day, the last at 23:25 Z. Casualty streams continue to surge: Weathered Expanse reports accelerating losses on both sides (≈ 780 colonial and 1 600 warden per hour), Clahstra and Dead Lands each exceed 500 casualties per hour per faction, and Loch Mor, Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow sustain steep but steady attrition. The overall strategic picture still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
